transcript: Speaker A: Hello, what is your name? Speaker B: My name is Rahul. Speaker A: How old are you? Speaker B: I have 22. Speaker A: "I have 22" nahi Rahul, "I am 22 years old" hota hai. ["I have 22" no Rahul, it is "I am 22 years old".] Speaker B: Okay, okay. I am 22 years old. Speaker A: Where are you from? Speaker B: I am uttar pradesh. Speaker A: "I am uttar pradesh" nahi, "I am from uttar pradesh" hoga. ["I am uttar pradesh" no, it will be "I am from uttar pradesh".] Speaker B: O theek hai, mujhe English achhe se nahi aati. [Oh okay, I don't know English very well.] Speaker A: Koi problem nahi, isiliye to main yahan hoon. Kya aapne kabhi AI teacher try kiya? [No problem, that's why I am here. Have you ever tried an AI teacher?] Speaker B: Wo to mehnge hote honge na? [They must be expensive, right?] Speaker A: Bilkul nahi. Normal English classes se SpeakEasy 7 guna sasta hai. Isiliye to 1 crore se jyada log SpeakEasy par English practice kar rahe hain. [Not at all. SpeakEasy is 7 times cheaper than normal English classes. That's why more than 1 crore people are practicing English on SpeakEasy.] Speaker B: Par practice ka time nahi milta. [But I don't get time to practice.] Speaker A: Roz ki sirf 15 se 20 minute ki practice kaafi hai. Aap bilkul confident ho jaoge. [Just 15 to 20 minutes of daily practice is enough. You will become completely confident.] Speaker B: Wow, kaise join karun? [Wow, how do I join?] Speaker A: Bas ye install button dabao aur SpeakEasy app download karo. Sirf 15 dino mein tumhein improvement dikhne lagegi. Chalo shuru ho jao. [Just press this install button and download the SpeakEasy app. You will start seeing improvement in just 15 days. Come on, get started.] Speaker C: Abhi SpeakEasy app download karein aur farratedar English bolna shuru karein. [Download the SpeakEasy app now and start speaking fluent English.]
on_screen_text: I have 22 (red cross) / I am 22 years old (green tick) / I am uttar pradesh (red cross) / I am from uttar pradesh (green tick) / ME NO ENGLISH / SpeakEasy AI / Speak English Easily with SpeakEasy / Install Now
summary: A man gets his English grammar corrected by a giant phone's AI avatar. The AI highlights that SpeakEasy is affordable, convenient, and highly effective. A human presenter concludes with a call to action to download the app.
